title: Reading joined enrollment summaries
description: You can follow detailed rows into filtered and grouped aggregates.

steps.description: The first query links each enrollment to its student and course using their IDs. You select all columns from those matching rows.
The second query uses the same joins and keeps CS377 rows. You calculate an enrollment count and an average student age.

steps.question: Will the final query return one summary for the entire join?
steps.answer: No. GROUP BY CourseNum produces one summary per represented course, then ORDER BY places larger enrollment counts first.

steps.description: You see CS377 with count 2 and average age 20.5, followed by CS173 with count 1 and average age 18.0. The earlier filtered aggregate prints 2 and 20.5.
